argv:
printf 'ENV_HOME=%s
ENV_TMPDIR=%s
ENV_CUDA=%s
' "$HOME" "$TMPDIR" "$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
test "$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES" = ''
test "$OMP_NUM_THREADS" = 1
test "$OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS" = 1
test "$MKL_NUM_THREADS" = 1
test "$VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS" = 1
test "$NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS" = 1
test "$BLIS_NUM_THREADS" = 1
printf 'CWD=%s
' "$PWD"
grep Cpus_allowed_list /proc/self/status
printf 'MOUNTINFO_BEGIN
'
cat /proc/self/mountinfo
printf 'MOUNTINFO_END
'
test -z "$(find /dev -name 'nvidia*' -print -quit)"
printf 'output
' > "$1/output/write.txt"
printf 'home
' > "$HOME/write.txt"
printf 'tmpdir
' > "$TMPDIR/write.txt"
printf 'tmp
' > /tmp/i61-review-write.txt
printf 'vartmp
' > /var/tmp/i61-review-write.txt
if (printf 'must not write
' > "$1/sources/fixture.txt") 2> "$1/output/ro_error.txt"; then
    echo 'READONLY_FIXTURE_WRITABLE'; exit 42
fi
printf 'BINARY_HASHES_BEGIN
'
/usr/bin/sha256sum /opt/relion/bin/relion_reconstruct /opt/relion/bin/relion_postprocess
printf 'BINARY_HASHES_END
'
